core_question: A dinner bill comes to $40. If you leave a 15% tip, how much is the tip in dollars? (secondary: A student scored 65, 80, and 92 on three assignments. What is the average score?)
answer_summary: the tip of $6 (15% of a $40 bill); after the topic shift: an average of 79 (from scores of 65, 80, and 92)
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang
